mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in labor market conditions (UNRATE > 4.5%) and manufacturing output (INDPRO < 100) indicates a deepening economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: dual deterioration in labor and manufacturing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% and INDPRO < 100 (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% over three months signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% over 3 months (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,200,000 annualized units indicate a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST is below 1,200,000 units (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO is above 100 (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 240.0 signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt accelerated Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0 (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing activity (HOUST < 1,200,000 units) and retail sales (RSAFS < 450,000 million dollars) reflect a broad-based consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0 and RSAFS < 450000.0 (10-year rolling window).
